purpose: Prove age-independent arithmetic and enclosure invariants for explicit finite representations, while preserving unresolved inference and integration obligations.
quantifier: For every finite prefix of every stream satisfying the stated contract, regardless of prefix length. Finite tests corroborate implementation correspondence; they do not establish this quantifier.
numerical_reference: Exact integer or real arithmetic on the same represented input codes, tick intervals, ratios, state domain and certificate semantics.

acquisition.intervals: Use actual represented intervals; do not replace them with nominal 1/35 s.
acquisition.order: Caller delivers observations in acquisition order and carries physical state across them.
acquisition.zero_interval: An admitted zero interval produces exact identity attenuation; its observation meaning is a caller obligation.
caller_obligations: Stable declared physical units and code interpretation
Chronology and a delivery protocol whose complete storage is explicitly accounted; no hidden unbounded external counter
Atomic composition of all updates belonging to one observation
No report of a rejected observation as propagated state

execution_model.language: C99 with available int32_t, uint32_t, int64_t, uint64_t
assumptions: Conforming compiler and C integer execution semantics
Initialized trusted objects and valid nonoverlapping storage as required by the API
No concurrent mutation, memory corruption, power-loss recovery or hardware fault during a primitive call

failure_semantics.negative_return: Destination remains byte-identical; the requested transition did not occur.
failure_semantics.empty_evidence_intersection: Commit empty active mask and return positive SCM_STABLE_INCONSISTENT; later certificates do not restore cells.
failure_semantics.composed_transaction: Not implemented. Several individually atomic calls are not automatically an atomic observation update.

charge.representation: int64 value, lower, upper; int32 current_code; uint32 ticks
charge.admission: P_0 and every exact prefix lie in the fixed int64 application interval [lower,upper].
charge.physical_interpretation: I_k=c_I*current_code_k; dt_k=c_t*ticks_k; charge_Ah=(c_I*c_t/3600)*P_n, with declared exact scales.
charge.guarantee: Exact represented-input integral for every admitted prefix; no rounding term or age-only exhaustion.

attenuation.input: q=num/den; num and den uint32; den>0
attenuation.construction: Exact zero; analytic [0,1]/D for q>=32; outward ratio and at most eight halvings, P7/P6 interval bounds, then outward squaring.
attenuation.unity: D requires 33 bits; multiplication by this endpoint is handled before uint64 multiplication.
limits: The ratio encodes the argument exactly; continuous parameter and acquisition conversion remain separate.
Positive q can yield A_hi=D; numerical contraction must be checked rather than assumed.

dissipative_state.representation: int32 lower, upper, bound; integer forcing target b in the same declared quantum; real exact state may lie between grid points
guarantees: Four exact int64 corner numerators and directed division produce a containing interval.
The output stays in [-B,B] at every finite execution length.
A_lo=A_hi=D leaves the full state object unchanged, with zero width growth.

conditional_usefulness.premises: On active updates A_hi<=D-g with g>0 and A_hi-A_lo<=h. Exact identities may occur arbitrarily often between active updates.
conditional_usefulness.gate: Multiply by the physical state quantum and compare with a justified application tolerance. Domain-wide containment alone is not useful precision.

finite_evidence.candidate_semantics: Retention of certified cell exclusions at a declared finite spatial resolution.
finite_evidence.representation: uint64 immutable domain and active masks; at most 64 fixed parameter cells
finite_evidence.static_episode: Each bit has one immutable cell interpretation and one fixed model/error contract. Parameter drift, chart changes and restored state require separate transport proof.
finite_evidence.compatible_sets: F_n is the exact compatible static-parameter set after prefix n; F_n subset F_(n-1). Cells B_j cover the admitted domain.
finite_evidence.certificate_requirement: J(F_n) subset C_n for EVERY supplied certificate. Every cell intersecting the compatible set must be retained, including overlapping cells.
finite_evidence.insufficient_premise: Merely requiring the union of retained overlapping cells to cover F_n is unsound under mask intersection.
finite_evidence.initialization_and_update: A_0 is the complete domain; A_n=A_(n-1) intersect C_n.
guarantees: J(F_n) subset A_n for every finite prefix under the certificate premise.
All-domain and duplicate certificates are exact identities or idempotent updates.
At most K strict cell removals occur for K cells; no weight or count grows.
An empty mask reports inconsistency. A nonempty mask can contain false positives and does not prove feasibility.
finite_evidence.conditional_learning: For a target cell set T, if each unwanted cell receives a sound whole-cell excluding certificate at a finite event, finitely many such events yield A_n subset T forever afterward. No uniform event time or existence guarantee is supplied.
finite_evidence.query_requirement: Return sound outer target ranges over all surviving cells; report unknown if the range is too wide. No SOC/capacity query kernel is implemented here.
finite_evidence.observation_error_model: Unresolved for the battery provider. Existing Gaussian sigma=1mV is not a deterministic finite error bound. A bounded-error or simultaneous probabilistic certificate model must be justified explicitly.
finite_evidence.historical_evidence_rule: Keep old likelihood/precision results as their original evidence. Do not convert them into hard exclusions, add a posterior prior to replayed raw factors, or claim semantic equivalence.

closed_at_this_checkpoint: Source-level range and induction arguments for isolated kernels
Conditional finite-evidence soundness and refinement proofs
Small exact-reference falsification and explicitly scoped host memory accounting
open_gates: Concrete finite parameter cover and sound battery certificate producer
Nonvacuous conditional SOC/capacity learning under justified stimulus and error assumptions
Outward query, unit conversion, uncertain target and parameter-ratio arithmetic
Coupled sensitivities and any model-state transport required by the chosen provider
Chronology, per-observation transaction, persistence, recovery and parameter drift
Complete integrated memory, latency and target compiler/platform qualification
